The two days of structured stops reach a list only once each day is a ListItem and each stop something like a TouristAttraction: per-child typing, not a flat mapping (WORK-567). Generating this fixture also prints a pre-existing engine diagnostic, "`itinerary-stop` requires parent `itinerary` — found nested directly in `itinerary-day`". Out of scope here — noted so it is not mistaken for fixture breakage later.

fixtures.notes: Was the D2 record: `type="NonProfit"` passed the rune's curated six-value enum and was published verbatim, though schema.org has no `NonProfit` type. WORK-568 corrected the enum to `NGO` — a breaking change for any site writing the old value, which now fails Markdoc validation instead of publishing a type no consumer resolves. The fixture writes `NGO` so this row records the corrected vocabulary; the old one survives in this file's history.
